job_contract.primary_job: Audit the Operational Excellence incident estate against a prior snapshot and generate a decisions-first Daily OpEx Digest with owner obligations, progress, stalled work, DPAs, postmortems, evidence caveats, and optional incident drill-downs.
job_contract.use_when: The user needs a current-versus-prior Operational Excellence board, DPA or postmortem tracking, owner accountability, estate patterns, or executive incident-review preparation.
job_contract.works_on: Current and prior normalized incident snapshots backed by Jira records, DPA records, postmortem bodies, policy inputs, and retrieval coverage evidence.
job_contract.main_output: A validated snapshot pair, evidence and comparison ledgers, and a deterministic Daily OpEx Digest in HTML with optional Markdown and incident drill-downs.
job_contract.not_for: Active Incident Commander process support, Git-only engineering activity, broad weekly intelligence, or modifying Jira, Drive, owners, priorities, links, or statuses.
job_contract.authority: Read incident and document evidence and write local audit artifacts only; external mutations, messages, uploads, and distribution require separate explicit authorization.
job_contract.routing_question: Does this request require a stateful Operational Excellence incident-estate audit and Daily OpEx Digest?
